name: Kuga Touji
source:
Shiou's butler, who almost acts like a foster father. He's been by his side ever since he was young.

Contrary to his master, he is a calm gentleman.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
